purpose: Versioned field contract for scientific claim/result nodes. This package holds pointers and metadata only; it is not a status database and does not promote mathematics.

claim_id.notes: Stable identifier. Prefer existing claims/graph.json or Math- GRAPH.json IDs when bridging.

statement.notes: Statement text or pointer to the authoritative statement carrier. Not acceptance.

depends_on.notes: Typed dependency edges. Edge presence here does not classify or promote either endpoint.

verification_level.notes: L0–L5 evidence metadata only. Level is never scientific acceptance or CONTROLLING promotion.

source_authority.notes: Must name an authority listed in AUTHORITY_MAP.json. This package never owns grades/statuses/classifications.

forbidden_owned_fields_reason: Those fields belong to external authorities (claims firewall, Math- hard gate, math_status registers). Duplicating them here would create a competing status store.
